query: SELECT as2.id, as2.activityId, as2.studentId, as2.status, as2.submittedAt, a.title as activityTitle, a.userId as professorId FROM activity_submissions as2 JOIN activities a ON a.id = as2.activityId ORDER BY as2.submittedAt DESC LIMIT 10;
